The '''Mission to Coruscant''' was a mission carried out by the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] to discover the nature of [[Sarlacc Project]]. After some investigations and violent encounters with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], they tracked the project to [[Imeici Spire]], where it was based. After infiltrating the tower, they learned details of the project. However, they were confronted by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Nolor]], who they killed. Just before he died, he activated the tower's self destruct, although the team were still able to escape unharmed.
